proof:
have hz : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num
  have hprod : i * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := by rw [h₀]
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hz)
  calc
    i * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := hprod
    _ = (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) := by
      norm_num
      ring
